summary: Group node progress by actions, active work, ready services and completed preparation
details: The startup and status --watch panels use distinct headings, state symbols and indented diagnostics. Healthy services show height and uptime without completed or empty progress bars; failures, stale observations, waiting reasons and recovery commands remain visible.
Optional minting displays Bitcoin txindex height coverage and Ord separately from core node readiness. Height coverage does not certify index readiness or estimate remaining time.

Use status --watch --details or status --details for full identity, block hashes and healthy component diagnostics. Redirected output and terminals without Unicode support use plain text markers; narrow output wraps diagnostics instead of truncating them.
Text rendering is isolated from observation and startup control, included in the release node kit, and leaves progress JSON, readiness gates and resource policy unchanged.
